rows.grounds: locative plural of compound referring to womb-mechanisms
past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: By what count and in what setting are certain beings said to endure torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the setting.
That count applies within thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings located in those womb-diagrams are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
